# Albashi

> Albashi pays your freelancers in naira, and its agent can only pay the payslip you signed.

A payroll agent for small agencies on Celo mainnet. The owner signs a payslip (who is paid, how much in naira, the lowest exchange rate they accept, a deadline). The agent buys cNGN with USD₮ on Textile FX and the payroll contract (PayRun) pays each signed line, and nothing else. The agent acts from the owner's Altana wallet under a permission that may call only PayRun.run; the owner can end it in one transaction.

Everything on the pages is read from Celo or Textile when the page loads. Limits are stated on the home page under "What isn't true yet": not audited; pay runs so far came from the Albashi team's own agency wallet, one of them to a real freelancer (₦1,500 to a photographer in Lagos, 28 Nov); cashing cNGN out to a bank is still being checked with him.

## Pages

- [Proof page](https://albashi.vercel.app/): the thesis, the latest pay run as alerts, and live checks of a mined run against Celo
- [Owner desk](https://albashi.vercel.app/desk): the last pay run (each signed line and its payment), the agent's limits, the payroll balance, and a live check that PayRun refuses a payee the owner didn't sign
- [A payment receipt](https://albashi.vercel.app/receipt/0x7b5e0bb86b691472947a463461e92d0235c74256eaac8ae7d1b0e42af3251b94/1): what a freelancer receives

## Check it yourself

- PayRun (payroll contract), Celo mainnet: 0xfa8d963525d5F28427B897A0C761C744A43e59Af — source verified on Sourcify: https://repo.sourcify.dev/42220/0xfa8d963525d5F28427B897A0C761C744A43e59Af
- Pay run signed by the owner on the desk: https://celoscan.io/tx/0x7b5e0bb86b691472947a463461e92d0235c74256eaac8ae7d1b0e42af3251b94
- Live refusal (no wallet, nothing sent): POST https://albashi.vercel.app/api/try
- Agent identity (ERC-8004, agent 10095): https://albashi.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-registration.json
- Source, evidence and decisions: https://github.com/emmanuelist/albashi (docs/EVIDENCE.md lists every proof)
